name: free-delegate
description: Offloads simple, self-contained tasks to a free model on any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenRouter free models, Groq, Gemini, local Ollama).

baseUrl.title: API base URL
baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 · Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1 · Groq: https://api.groq.com/openai/v1

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Key for the endpoint (free OpenRouter key from openrouter.ai/keys). Leave empty for Ollama, or set OPENROUTER_API_KEY / FREE_MODEL_API_KEY instead.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id. On OpenRouter pick one ending in :free (run /free-models to list them).

nudge.title: Nudge Claude to delegate
nudge.description: Add a short system-prompt note telling Claude when to use the delegate tool.
